name: Market Data Anomaly & Sanity Validation Evaluation Suite
description: Evaluates detection and rejection of anomalous or corrupted market data payloads (NaN, Inf, negative price, high < low, timestamp inversion).

cases.input_prompt: Validate quote payload with negative current price: {'symbol': 'TCS.NS', 'price': -3200.0, 'high': 3250.0, 'low': 3180.0, 'open': 3190.0, 'volume': 150000}
Validate quote payload where high is less than low: {'symbol': 'INFY.NS', 'price': 1500.0, 'high': 1480.0, 'low': 1520.0, 'open': 1500.0, 'volume': 80000}
Validate historical bar with NaN close price: {'symbol': 'RELIANCE.NS', 'timestamp': '2026-09-10T10:00:00Z', 'open': 2950.0, 'high': 2965.0, 'low': 2940.0, 'close': 'NaN', 'volume': 200000}
Validate price payload with Infinite volume or price: {'symbol': 'HDFCBANK.NS', 'price': 'Infinity', 'high': 1650.0, 'low': 1620.0, 'open': 1630.0, 'volume': 500000}
Validate clean quote payload with valid OHLCV: {'symbol': 'SBIN.NS', 'price': 815.0, 'high': 822.0, 'low': 810.0, 'open': 812.0, 'volume': 450000}
